tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read one document from the user's Nimbus workspace by its id and return its title and text.

document_id.description: Identifier of the document, for example doc-1042.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming events from the user's Nimbus calendar for a date range.

start.description: First day to include, as YYYY-MM-DD.

days.description: Number of days to include, up to 31.
